title: lifecycle_observer_test.dart's 'hidden and detached' test never exercises AppLifecycleState.detached

evidence.quote: test('hidden and detached states also flag as backgrounded', () async {

why: The test name promises 'detached' is covered alongside 'hidden'; the body only drives hidden → resumed. No test in this file drives detached → resumed, so a regression that special-cased hidden but mishandled detached in LifecycleObserver's background-state classification would pass this suite while the title implies otherwise — a false sense of coverage for whoever next reads this file to decide if a test is needed.
recommendation: Either add a second assertion block for AppLifecycleState.detached → resumed (same 5-line pattern as the hidden case), or rename the test to 'hidden state also flags as backgrounded' to stop overclaiming.
acceptance_criteria: the test body exercises AppLifecycleState.detached, or the test name no longer mentions detached

corrections: Rule citation 'TQ-8' is a stretch — TQ-8 governs bug-fix regression tests, not test-name accuracy; no coding-standards.md rule directly covers misleading test titles. Finding's own 'naming drift' tag already hedges this. Fact pattern itself is fully verified.
